thread:
Jordan - Sales: Quick sync — NimbusHealth POC: they want final eval harness + SOW + pricing. Major asks: golden dataset, scoring rubric, regression gates, timeline, and info for security questionnaire. Who can own the harness spec?
Anya (SE): I can draft the golden set. Thinking ~200 gold examples (150 core intents + 50 edge/error cases) and 500 validation examples. Keep a mix of short/long prompts, PHI-like redacted examples, and ambiguous queries.
Samir (Solutions Eng): +1. For scoring, propose a categorical rubric 0-3 (0=fail,1=partial,2=ok,3=perfect) per example, plus an automatic fuzzy-match threshold for factual items. I'll paste a snippet we can use in CI:
Samir (Solutions Eng): ```python
# simplified scoring
def score(pred, gold):
    if pred == gold: return 3
    if overlap(pred, gold) > 0.6: return 2
    if overlap(pred, gold) > 0.3: return 1
    return 0
```
Samir (Solutions Eng): Also add an intent-coverage map and per-intent pass rate gate (e.g., each intent >= 80%).
Marta (Security): Heads up — NimbusHealth handles PHI. They'll want clarification on data-in-transit/storage, KMS, and whether logs contain any PII. We should declare: hosted option is fine with data retention controls, but for PHI recommend Private deployment (VPC + customer-managed KMS).
Lee (PM): Proposed success criteria to include in SOW:
Lee (PM): - Quality: aggregate score >= 2.2 across gold set (weighted by intent importance) and no intent < 0.8 pass rate
Lee (PM): - Latency: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 800ms under pilot QPS
Lee (PM): - Regression gates: daily CI run on gold set; block if mean score drops > 5% vs baseline
Jordan - Sales: Good. Timeline ask from customer: 4-week pilot from kickoff. Can we hit that if SEs prepare harness in 1 week? Also need an indicative price for Dedicated vs Hosted for pilot capacity.
Samir (Solutions Eng): We can deliver harness draft in 5 business days if I get an initial seed of 50 representative prompts from Nimbus. I'll own CI integration.
Samir (Solutions Eng): For pricing — quick estimate: Hosted pilot (up to 20k tokens/day) ~ $X/day + support; Dedicated trial (small reserved pool) adds baseline monthly commit — I'll DM finance for exact banding. For negotiation: offer 4-week trial discount and optional uplift for Private.
Marta (Security): I'll start filling security questionnaire. Need a point of contact at Nimbus for infra questions and a list of sample PHI elements they expect to send (we can also propose pseudonymization).
EvalBot: New artifact uploaded: "nimbus-goldenset-v1.csv" — CI hook added. https://g.re.redwood/nimbus/goldenset
